moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio grid-spiral, written here): 3×3 tiles appear in a clockwise spiral from the centre: row-major indices 4, 5, 8, 7, 6, 3, 0, 1, 2; each scales 0 → 1 in 320 ms back.out, starting 128 ms after the previous (whole run ≈1.35 s); the first tile in the accent colour. Params: order (4,5,8,7,6,3,0,1,2) · step (128 ms) · each (0.32 s) · ease (back.out).
